bm10.subtitle: 1-tonne mini excavator · Ideal for light work and tight spaces
bm10.description: BM10 is a compact mini excavator for light earthworks, gardening and installation work. Thanks to its small dimensions, it works well wherever a larger machine would have limited access. It is a simple and practical model for everyday work around properties, foundations, cables and small excavations.

bm12.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator · More weight, the same compact format
bm12.description: BM10 is a model with a higher operating weight, designed for more demanding earthworks while maintaining compact transport dimensions. It offers a good compromise between mobility and working stability and performs well both in installation work and everyday construction tasks.

bm12c.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator with cab · Operator comfort all year round
bm12c.description: BM10C is the cab version of BM10, designed for work in less favourable weather conditions and wherever the operator expects greater comfort. The base platform parameters remain consistent with BM10; the difference is the body version and usage style.

bm12-kubota.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator · Version with Kubota Diesel engine
bm12-kubota.description: BM10 Kubota is a variant of the BM10 model with the same technical parameters and working geometry, but equipped with a Kubota Diesel engine. It is a version for customers who want to keep the compact dimensions of BM10 while choosing a stronger engine brand.

bm12c-kubota.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator with cab · Version with Kubota Diesel engine
bm12c-kubota.description: BM10C Kubota is the counterpart of BM10C with the same working parameters, but with a Kubota Diesel engine. It is a premium variant for customers who want to combine an operator cab with a higher-class power unit.

upcoming.subtitle: New models — coming soon
upcoming.description: More Bergson Machines models will appear in this section.

bm13.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator · KOOP 192F · expandable tracks
bm13.description: BM11 is a compact 1.2 t mini excavator with a KOOP 192F engine, prepared for earthworks, installation and garden jobs. Expandable 850-1050 mm tracks make it easier to pass through narrower spaces, while digging depth up to 1,750 mm works well for everyday work around properties and on small construction sites.

bm13-kubota.subtitle: 1.2-tonne mini excavator · Kubota D722 · expandable tracks
bm13-kubota.description: BM11 Kubota uses the same compact 1.2 t platform as the standard BM11, but runs on a Kubota D722 engine. It is a variant for customers who want to keep the machine’s small dimensions and choose a branded 3-cylinder unit.

bm16.subtitle: 1.6-tonne mini excavator · Laidong 385 · greater working reach
bm16.description: BM15 is a larger 1.6 t platform with a Laidong 385 engine, wider 1100-1300 mm track spacing and digging depth up to 1,800 mm. The model is designed for more demanding earthworks, installation and construction jobs where greater stability and working reach matter.

bm16-kubota.subtitle: 1.6-tonne mini excavator · Kubota D722 · greater working reach
bm16-kubota.description: BM15 Kubota is based on the 1.6 t platform and working geometry of BM15, but uses a Kubota D722 engine. It is a variant for customers who want to combine greater working reach with a compact machine powered by a branded engine.

bm16c.subtitle: 1.6-tonne mini excavator with cab · Laidong 385 · year-round comfort
bm16c.description: BM15C combines a 1.6 t platform with a full operator cab and Laidong 385 engine. It is a variant for users who want to keep BM15 working parameters while working more comfortably in cold weather, rain and during longer shifts.

bm16c-kubota.subtitle: 1.6-tonne mini excavator with cab · Kubota D722 · year-round comfort
bm16c-kubota.description: BM15C Kubota is the cab variant of the 1.6 t platform with a Kubota D722 engine. The model is prepared for customers who expect a full operator cab, expandable tracks and a branded engine in one configuration.

bm25-ricardo.description: BM25 Ricardo is a silent 25 kW generator for backup power and field work. As standard, you receive ATS, AVR, a SmartGen HGM6120 controller and a declared delivery time of 15 days.
